design.comparison: Paired replay: one live response per task; filter match >=0.5 for both arms; baseline input order vs stable descending score. No extra ranking calls.
design.labels: Author-defined before inference. 0 unrelated or contradicts requested facts; 1 relevant but incomplete; 2 independently supplies every requested fact. Each task is fictional, public synthetic text. No external truth claim.
design.metrics: Macro precision@k (TP/k, empty slots count zero), candidate-pool recall (TP/all grade>=1), graded nDCG@k using gain 2^grade-1, answer-complete precision@k (grade2/k). Empty gold recall and nDCG are zero. Report per-task outcomes without exclusions.
design.sufficiency_probe: Unsafe hypothetical heuristic only, not CLI output: any selected match implies answer sufficient. False-sufficient if selected nonempty but no selected grade2; false-insufficient if empty despite grade2 anywhere in pool. No generated answers or calibrated sufficiency predictions.
design.acceptance: Ranking passes exploratory gate only if macro nDCG@2 strictly improves, macro relevance precision@2 does not fall, and false-sufficient count does not increase. No significance or generalization claim. Do not change labels, order, query, k, threshold, metric or gate after inference. All six attempts included; any request failure makes study incomplete, no retries.
